item.title: Mint Explainer | What happened aboard Air India flight 2379 from Phuket?
item.description: Airbus has outlined what happened aboard Air India flight 2379, but the cause of its sudden altitude loss remains unclear as investigators examine the aircraft and pilot response.

item.title: EV bike startup RapteeHV in talks to raise $15-20 million in Series A round
item.description: RapteeHV is raising fresh capital to ramp up production and expand its retail network as investor interest in India’s electric-vehicle sector shifts towards larger bets.

item.title: After Dhoot, Bain-backed RSB Transmissions begins talks with bankers for ₹3,000 cr IPO
item.description: Founded in 1973 by R.K. Behera and S.K. Behera, RSB specializes in designing and manufacturing components for commercial vehicles, passenger cars, construction and off-highway equipment.

item.title: Financial advisors love Warren Buffett, but they don’t always agree with him
item.description: Money pros explain when they embrace the Oracle of Omaha’s investing wisdom and when they encourage clients to take a different approach.

item.title: Axis Max Life sees margin gains holding firm as product mix settles
item.description: CEO Sumit Madan rules out near-term product changes as VNB margins surge to 23.2%, buoyed by strong demand for retirement products, protection sales, and channel expansion.

item.title: Microsoft, Salesforce eye Darwinbox buyout ahead of its planned IPO
item.description: HR and payroll services provider Darwinbox is drawing buyout interest from Microsoft, Salesforce and ADP even as it prepares for a potential IPO. The interest comes as the KKR-backed firm expands overseas, giving its founders and investors another option as they chart the company’s next phase.

item.title: Georgia Military School Embarks on Turnaround Post-Debt Reprieve
item.description: Riverside Military Academy, an all-boys boarding and day school in Gainesville, Georgia, has entered into a forbearance agreement after defaulting on its debt obligations, according to a market disclosure.

item.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ stakes as California child privacy trial could change Instagram, Facebook forever
item.description: Meta faces 'astronomical' consequences as child privacy trial in California could change Instagram, Facebook forever

item.title: Paytm founder Sharma to sell stake worth up to ₹4,895 crore in block deal
item.description: As of June-end, Sharma's Resilient was listed as a public shareholder with just over 10% stake in the Paytm parent. Resilient is a Netherlands-registered holding firm that Sharma set up to acquire a 10.3% ownership and voting interest in One 97 Communications from Ant Group Co. affiliate Antfin.

item.title: Jio vs Airtel: the base plan is now the new telecom battleground
item.description: The move from Reliance Jio, whose tariffs already trade at a discount to peers, could affect Airtel’s strategy to upgrade base-level plan users to higher tariffs. The pricing divergence also puts the spotlight on Vodafone Idea.

item.title: Who is Sam Mehta? L3Harris names replacement for ousted CEO Christopher Kubasik
item.description: Incoming CEO Sam Mehta, 53, joined L3Harris in 2023. He had led L3Harris's Space &amp; Mission Systems and Communications &amp; Spectrum Dominance segments, which together account for about 80% of total revenue.

item.title: OpenAI leadership exits: Brockman calls turnover ‘atypical’ after Denise Dresser, Brad Lightcap quit
item.description: OpenAI is undergoing another senior leadership reshuffle just as the ChatGPT maker enters one of the most consequential phases of its expansion

item.title: Colgate collaborates with Bombay Shaving Company for Palmolive ads
item.description: &nbsp;The partnership, aimed at leveraging Bombay Shaving's D2C expertise, comes as the Palmolive brand experiences disappointing sales performance.

item.title: Tata Capital Healthcare Fund leads $30 million investment in Tenet Diagnostics
item.description: Tata Capital Healthcare Fund and Blue Earth Capital have put $30 million into Tenet Diagnostics, marking one of the first deployments from TCHF's newly closed Fund III.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Our cyber defence must evolve faster’: SEBI chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey launches 2 new portals for digital security
item.description: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced two new portals to strengthen cybersecurity and incident reporting in the securities market. The move aims to improve information sharing, cyber resilience, and preparedness as threats become increasingly sophisticated.

item.title: Who is Shabnam Sinha? Former World Bank professional named Airtel Payments Bank Chairperson
item.description: Sunil Mittal, founder and chairman of Bharti Enterprises, will conclude his tenure as non-executive Chairman and step down from the board, effective 30 September 2026

item.title: Noel Tata, N Chandrasekaran both separately briefed govt on rift, concerns before latter's exit as Chairman: Report
item.description: Noel Tata and N Chandrasekaran both separately met with and briefed the government on their rift and concerns over strategy and governance before the latter's exit as Chairman, according to a TOI report.&nbsp;

item.title: Airtel Payments Bank names Shabnam Sinha as chairperson; Sunil Bharti Mittal to step down
item.description: Airtel Payments Bank appoints Shabnam Sinha as chairperson from October 1, succeeding Sunil Bharti Mittal, who steps down after a decade.

item.title: NCLT pulls up SpiceJet for ‘wasting court’s time’, as airline settles one of eight insolvency claims on order day
item.description: The NCLT bench asked Spicejet to settle its dues with other creditors within two days and said it will now pass an order on Wednesday

item.title: Coal India weighs more iron ore bids as it plans a pelletization plant
item.description: The coal miner plans to bid for more iron ore blocks, but only where the economics work, as it prepares to enter pelletization after winning an Odisha mine at a 114% premium.

item.title: Global PE fund Permira may lead race to acquire $150-200 mn stake in Cloudnine Hospitals
item.description: The likely deal will be secondary in nature, with existing investor True North looking to sell its over decade-old stake in Cloudnine

item.title: Anthropic IPO valuation hinges on $190-200 billion 2028 revenue forecast, sources say
item.description: ANTHROPIC-IPO:Anthropic IPO valuation hinges on $190-200 billion 2028 revenue forecast, sources say

item.title: HP executive calls Gen Z ‘AI native’, lauds their ability to listen, build trust, understand customers need
item.description: An HP executive described Gen Z as 'AI native', highlighting their strong listening skills, ability to build trust and comfort with technology. He emphasized their role in driving innovation.

item.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX holdings revealed. (Hint: It’s a lot.)
item.description: The CEO controls 6.4 billion SpaceX shares, almost half of the stock outstanding.

item.title: Page Industries bets on a future beyond innerwear even as margin pressure remains
item.description: Managing director V.S. Ganesh said that Page won’t enter a category unless it can outsell the next three competitors combined, and claims to already meet that bar in lingerie and athleisure.

item.title: Yotta targets $1.5 billion raise in FY27, including India IPO
item.description: The data centre firm plans to raise most of the money from private-equity investors before the IPO, which could raise up to $400 million.

item.title: India still lacks enough high-grade steel, leaving pipe makers relying on imports: Sminu Jindal
item.description: Domestic mills are developing specialized grades for oil and gas pipelines, but limited volumes and high prices are keeping the pipe maker dependent on imports.

item.title: Chinese carmakers open doors for Mahindra's global push
item.description: The company has marked out South Africa, the UK, Australia, New Zealand and Latin American countries, including Brazil, as it evaluates an expansion in these countries using new pickup trucks and passenger vehicles.

item.title: Stripe Clinches Over $7 Billion Deal to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter
item.description: Stripe Inc. has finalized an agreement to acquire OpenRouter Inc., a startup that helps companies switch between artificial intelligence models, for more than $7 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Amber to start making Oppo, OnePlus, Realme phones in March 2027 quarter, double output in 2nd year
item.description: Amber Enterprises India Executive Chairman &amp; CEO and whole-time director Jasbir Singh, during the company's earnings call, said that firm expects to start with production of 8 million units of Oppo group smartphone brands and scale it twofold to around 16 million units in 2nd year of operations.

item.title: House of Abhinandan Lodha targets 40 boutique resorts in five years
item.description: House of Abhinandan Lodha plans to establish 40 boutique resorts under its Miros brand, focusing on luxury experiences rather than conventional hotels. The initial properties will be in Goa, with others planned across Maharashtra and Ayodhya over the next five years.

item.title: Biyani's Style Union seeks to raise ₹800 crore as value retail market expands
item.description: Style Union, which is operated by Nexon Omniverse, was launched in 2022 by Rakesh Biyani and Ekta Biyani to make everyday fast-fashion for men, women, and children more affordable. It opened its first stores in Hyderabad and Bengaluru and has expanded to over 170 outlets in the past four years.

item.title: Mint Explainer | Why India Inc is retaining more of its profits
item.description: Dividends hit a record ₹5.13 trillion in FY26, but payouts grew slower than profits, pushing the payout ratio to a 12-year low as companies retain more cash.

item.title: Nvidia-OpenAI partnership: US chipmaker plans to invest $3 billion in SB Energy; what we know
item.description: Nvidia is in talks to invest roughly $3 billion in SB Energy while discussing up to $100 billion in credit support for an Ohio data centre project for OpenAI.
